summary_i18n.en: Scholarship for Class 9 to 12 students from OBC, EBC and DNT families with income up to Rs 2.5 lakh.

source_title: PM YASASVI scheme for OBC, EBC and DNT students, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

label_i18n.en: From an OBC, EBC or DNT community
Parents' or guardian's yearly income from all sources is Rs 2.5 lakh or less
Marks in the earlier exam meet the cut-off

note_i18n.en: Money goes to students in schools chosen under the scheme. Check the current year's notice for dates.

research_note: NOT read in full: the Ministry PDF returned HTTP 503 on 2026-11-19, so these values come from an excerpt of that PDF seen in search results (2023-24 cycle). Income Rs 2.5 lakh and Classes 9 to 12 agree across sources. The marks cut-off is 60% in Class 8 or 10 in the PDF excerpt but 33% or 'passing marks' elsewhere, so it stays TODO_VERIFY. The scheme also needs entry through an empanelled school and a selection test; not modelled.
